menus.name: Holy Grail of Grazing
menus.description: Two sliders (50 of each), five cheeses, five meats, two salads, three dips, two hummus, two nuts, guacamole, pico de gallo, seasonal fruit and chips.

menus.name: Grand Graze
menus.description: Five sliders, four salads, three dips, two hummus, two nuts, chips and mini pudding cups: Oreo, butterscotch or banana.

menus.name: Super Graze
menus.description: Three sliders (25 each), three salads, three dips, two hummus, nuts, chips and a full vegetable spread.

menus.name: Grazing Standard
menus.description: Everything in Graze Me, Craze Me, plus a second hummus, two dips, pasta salad and potato, sweet-potato or tortilla chips.

menus.name: Graze Me, Craze Me
menus.description: Two sliders (30 of each), meat and cheese, seasonal fruit, hummus, almonds, two salads, roasted and raw vegetables, and one dip.
